subject: german
title: Classroom Furniture
welcome_lead: Tisch, Stuhl, Tafel — the classroom layout.
final_note: Larger items in the German classroom.

walkthroughs.body_html: Der Tisch = the table. Der Stuhl = the chair. Both masculine. 'Ich sitze am Tisch' = 'I sit at the table'.
Die Tafel = the board. Die Tur = the door. Das Fenster = the window. Mixed genders.
Die Schultasche literally means 'school-bag'. German is full of compound words like this. 'Schul' = school, 'Tasche' = bag.
